chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Al-Yaqoubi, from Musa ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Muyassar, from Harun ibn Al-Jahm, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Do not leave the crucified one after three (days), until he is brought down and buried.'

key_terms.الْمَصْلُوبَ: The crucified one (object of the ruling)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on leaving a crucified body unburied?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the Sunnah of dignified burial for those executed by crucifixion, limiting the exposure of the corpse to three days to prevent prolonged humiliation. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the principle of preserving the honor of the deceased, even if they were criminals, reflecting the Prophet's mercy and the practical need to prevent decay and public spectacle. It serves as a foundational text for the ritual treatment of martyrs and the executed in Islamic tradition.
